discrepancy_explanation.why_r1_said_14832: R1 mistyped train/val/test counts as 10489+2173+2170=14832. Actual on-disk split is train 10381, val 2225, test 2225, summing to exactly 14831.
discrepancy_explanation.why_r1_said_15448: R1 summed unverified raw numbers across some classes which mixed pre-dedup and post-dedup counts.
discrepancy_explanation.why_r1_said_13760_vs_10987: Excluding clothes(1892), shoes(1449), trash(503) = 3844 files from 14831 gives EXACTLY 10987 files, not 13760.
discrepancy_explanation.why_r2_reported_cross_source_zero: R2 had a reporting/hardcoded bug where cross_source_duplicates was set to 0 because all 923 excluded physical files were in vn_trash. In reality, 890 of those 923 files were duplicate copies (879 exact MD5, 11 near pHash) of primary files in garbage_v2.
